sub_answers.text: John Grant was instrumental in establishing the Junior National Wheelchair Games while President of the Paraplegic and Quadriplegic Association of New South Wales.[d37675808s4p0] Mount Wilga House included sports in rehabilitation programs and held annual Sports Days that integrated sport into rehabilitation.[d37675808s4p0] The Australian team to the 1960 Rome Paralympics included eight competitors who had been patients at Mt Wilga Rehabilitation Centre and trained by Kevin Betts and Eileen Perrottet, showing early pathways from rehabilitation to national competition.[d37675808s4p0]

sub_answers.text:
Para-swimming classification was originally based on medical criteria and later moved to a function-based classification system assessing functional disability [d36583541s0p0].
Governance of swimming classifications was the responsibility of FINA until 1992, after which the International Paralympic Committee oversaw classification [d36583541s0p0].
Swimmers are divided into classes S1–S10 for physical impairments and S11–S13 for visual impairments, with additional classes such as S14 and S15 for intellectual impairment and hearing loss respectively [d36583541s1p0][d36583541s0p0].
Classification assessment procedures include physical assessment, observation assessment, and functional assessment (which may include in-pool performance), and classifiers operate in panels including at least one person with a medical background [d36583541s4p0][d36583541s1p0].
